english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for making information publicly known, especially an official decision or event.
This is the all-purpose choice for formally or officially stating something.
This is the all-purpose choice for announcing or declaring something publicly.
Use this when voicing something means making an official public announcement.
Use this for publicly announcing information, decisions, or events rather than trying to sell something.
Use this for an official, authoritative, or ceremonial declaration rather than for saying a word aloud.

examples.english: The government will announce a price increase next week.
